title: Badge
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, empty mid-century office tower at night, flickering fluorescent green-white light, long polished corridors and brass elevator doors, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. My badge opened a door that wasn't there. The photo was decades old. 🪪

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: old blueprints showed a thirteenth floor, removed in 1958 after an incident. Then someone in the dark asked for Tess upstairs.
scenes.image: a woman in a dark basement archive staring up an empty stairwell

scenes.narration: When she turned, the stairwell was empty. Just the smell of pipe smoke, and a door closing somewhere far above.
scenes.image: an empty concrete stairwell spiraling upward into darkness, a faint haze of smoke

scenes.narration: She drove home at dawn and made up her mind. She'd quit. Tonight. Hand in the badge and never come back.
scenes.image: a woman sitting in her parked car at dawn outside a tall dark office tower, gripping the wheel

scenes.narration: At midnight, she came in to do it. The day guard was gone. His locker was empty. His name was missing from the schedule, like it had never been there.
scenes.image: an open empty metal locker in a security break room, a single coat hanger swinging

scenes.narration: She took one last round. On twelve, at the end of the hall, there was a door. Oak. Brass handle. It had never been there before.
scenes.image: a heavy old oak door with a brass handle at the end of a modern fluorescent-lit office corridor

scenes.narration: Next to it, a small black badge reader. Blinking red. Waiting.
scenes.image: close-up of a small black badge reader on a wall beside an oak door frame, a red light blinking

scenes.narration: She held her badge up. Just to see. The light turned green. The lock clicked.
scenes.image: a woman's hand holding a plastic badge up to a reader, the light glowing green, the oak door unlatching

scenes.narration: Tess looked down at the badge in her hand. Her face. But the photo was black and white. Her hair was pinned up. Her collar was from another era.
scenes.image: close-up of an old black-and-white portrait of a woman with pinned-up hair in a 1950s collar, worn photo edges

scenes.narration: It was her. Seventy years ago.
scenes.image: a woman's stunned face in fluorescent light, reflected faintly in the polished oak door

scenes.narration: Behind the oak door, a narrow staircase went up. And from the top, faint and clear, the sound of typewriters stopping. One by one.
scenes.image: a narrow wooden staircase rising behind an open oak door into warm yellow light, dust in the air
